about: What each program loads. CORE is true for every brand; a PACK is the business type (program.md `business:`); a MODULE is a program mechanic switched on by the pack's defaults, by the other program.md answers (modifiers) and by an optional `modules: +x, -y` line. `inbox program` reads this file and prints the pack, the modules and the per-block load plan. Module status: `built` (its doctrine lives in its file), `seed` (the rules moved here so far; the full module comes with a later pack), `planned` (no file yet). A file with `when` loads only on that trigger (`base_if` names the program answers that make it load every time); the rules that must hold without a module live in the core. Paths are relative to the plugin root; profile files are not listed.

block_1.when: a date, a reschedule (a repeat slip too) or a follow-up
a contracted draft or post past its agreed date that the creator hasn't moved
a fee payment, invoice, VAT or onboarding-form question (a program's own payout terms are its module shape's)
a decline, a deal deferred (never a date move), a new contact, an event or B2B
a tracking link, promo code, record change or a lookup beyond the creator's note
creating or updating a creator note (reading one is `inbox creator <name>`)

block_2.when: approving a video or final content, a final-green-light script pass, a published video, a launch-campaign code or an offer ending before the post date
a post went live without the approval the deal requires

block_3.when: set up rates, warehouse benchmarks or bulk pricing
more than one line or surface on the table, or a package
a matched scenario or an end-of-deal renegotiation
live pushback on our number (a second round or more), or a complex multi-party thread
they run negotiation plays on us
the creator asked for a call
either side cancels a booked deal, or asks what is owed on one (kill fee, product, a refund)

saas.label: software or an app: signups and paid subscriptions

ecommerce.label: physical products sold online: orders and revenue

block_2.when: the content, caption or brief makes a product claim (what it does, a result, safety, who it's for): the regulated list

b2b.label: something other businesses buy: demos and qualified leads

block_1.when: an affiliate rate, earning window or payout question; a decline; a performance-data ask

block_3.when: the reply names or prices the affiliate (Track A, a pushback or exit rung, a re-book package, a recalibration); commission asked about; renewing a creator on commission; a no-flat-fee verdict or a no-fee door; a creator-owned channel or multi-line pitch

a fee priced, countered or explained by views (median views x CPM): a first number or counter, a net-new first money conversation, a re-book at the engine's views rate, a mechanism dispute, a per-1K decline, a placement with no views band; not a recalibration priced on the creator's own results (conversion bar)

a renewal, re-book or top-up; a recalibration or its rejection; a volume ask or a single high-fee piece; a new creator's yes without numbers (Door B); late delivery; an upfront-payment ask; "other brands pay more"
a thread bound to a campaign, brief or seasonal moment (thread_binding): an offer or budget question, its dates, a moved or late post date, re-booking for the next one

block_1.when: product to send or already sent: a yes to a kit, a variant or shade pick, an address, a ship date, a missing or wrong package, a region we don't ship to, a post after a kit
product to send or already sent: a yes to a kit, a variant or shade pick, an address, a ship date, a missing or wrong package, a region we don't ship to, a post after a kit

block_3.when: product in a money thread: cash asked on top of a kit, a kit with or instead of a fee, a giveaway prize

rights are in the offer or the thread: any first-deal cash offer (mode included-first-deal); a renewal, re-book, recalibration, cut or volume ask from a returning creator; amplification, paid usage, an ad code (Spark or partnership ads), raw files or a repost; rights on their rate card or asked about
exclusivity in the thread: a brief that needs it, a line on their rate card or contract, a hold they have with another brand

block_3.when: a manager or agency speaks for the creator

when they get paid, an invoice, a PO number, a tax form, the supplier portal, or a payment late against the terms

a UGC creator or a UGC ask: content made for our channels, priced per asset

block_targets.about: design §3 goals per block (lines, worst case); block_budgets are the enforced ceilings, lowered by `python3 tests/test_repo.py --write-baseline` as files shrink

thread_binding: When more than one budget-model variant is on, each thread binds to one at triage: a thread tied to a named campaign or brief -> budget-campaign-pot; an established creator outside any campaign -> budget-always-on; anything ambiguous -> the first value listed in program.md. Two variants never load for one thread.
